design_rules: Keep it simple — readable at 28x28 pixels
High contrast against both light and dark backgrounds
No fine details that disappear at small sizes
Use channel accent color as background
profile_picture.format: PNG with transparency, sRGB color profile

design_rules: Logo center-left, value proposition on right
All critical text within center 1546x423 safe area
Test on desktop, tablet, and mobile before publishing
Update annually to stay fresh while maintaining core recognition

ratio.accent: 10% — high-contrast highlight for CTAs and emphasis

title_font.name: DM Sans
title_font.use: Thumbnail headlines, banner titles, chapter cards

body_font.name: Inter or Roboto
body_font.use: Video descriptions, community posts, end screen text

rules: Maximum 2 font families across entire channel
Title font for all thumbnail text
Body font for descriptions and readable text
Never use decorative/script fonts in thumbnails
Minimum 60pt at 1280x720 canvas for thumbnail text

templates.name: primary
templates.safe_zones: Keep bottom-right clear (duration badge), left 2/3 safest

consistency_rules: Use same 2-3 color palette on EVERY thumbnail
Same general layout position across videos
Viewers should recognize your content before reading the title
3-element system: color palette + font + layout structure

rules: Keep under 5 seconds — viewers skip long intros
Don't repeat in every video if upload frequency is high

outro.notes: Outro IS the end screen. Plan it into the video structure.

structure: Line 1: What the channel is about (keyword-rich)
Line 2: Upload schedule or content type
channel_description.example: Your constitutional rights explained in plain English. What to do during traffic stops, police encounters, and legal situations. | New videos every week | Subscribe for deep dives into legal education (know your rights)

watermark.notes: Branded watermark appears on all videos. Use subscribe button for growth.

cross_platform.rule: Same color palette, font, and logo across ALL platforms
cross_platform.notes: Viewers who discover you elsewhere should recognize the brand instantly on YouTube.
